entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment: The reduced rate is applied only if the supplier can prove that the goods, except foods with added sugar, whose total sugar content is at least 10g/100g product, are used as food for human or animal consumption. When those goods are imported from a third territory or a third country, the application of the reduced rate is conditioned by the submission of the Commitment Declaration regarding the destination of the goods. Point 37 para.(5)-(9) of Norms.

entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment:
- Foodstuffs referred to in article 2 in regulation EC no 178/2002 are subject to reduced VAT rate, with the exception for tap water and certain alcoholic beverages, see chapter 9 section 3 in the Swedish VAT Act.
- Goods with CN code 2203 can be subject to reduced VAT rate provided that the alcohol content is maximum 3.5 volume percent. Goods with CN code 28-29, 3201-3206, 3301-3302, 3501-3505, 3507 can be subject to reduced VAT rate if they constitute food additives.
